write_orca_input_files: write ORCA input files for a given molecular system with specified charge, multiplicity, and NBO options
estimate_orca_memory: estimate the memory requirement in MB for an ORCA calculation given atoms and spin multiplicity
count_basis_functions: count the number of basis functions for a set of atoms using the def2-TZVPD basis set
generate_symmetry_break_block: generate an ORCA SCF rotate block to break symmetry in open-shell singlet calculations
configure_geometry_optimization: configure geometry optimization parameters using Sella or LBFGS optimizer with specified force convergence thresholds
